title: Here are the Philippine Navy’s newest warships
summary: Meet the latest acquisitions that comprise the Navy's modern fleet

blocks.text: Meet the latest acquisitions that comprise the Navy's modern fleet

From guided-missile frigates and offshore patrol vessels to landing platform docks, these new warships signal a break from the Philippine Navy’s regime of hand-me-down vessels dating as far back as World War II.
In this video, Rappler security and diplomacy reporter Bea Cupin roll calls the Navy’s most recent acquisitions that comprise its finally modern fleet.

This project is produced as part of “Project Endurance: A Deep Dive into the Philippines’ Security Modernization Efforts” implemented by Rappler with funding from the Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung Philippines.
